description: React component for the mobile version of the channel header in Mattermost, handling sidebar toggling, rendering header elements, and managing UI interactions.

classes.name: MobileChannelHeader
classes.description: React component class for rendering the mobile channel header with sidebar controls and header content.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds click event listener to hide sidebars when component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes click event listener when component unmounts.

methods.name: hideSidebars
methods.description: Handles click events to close sidebars if in mobile view and click target is outside toggle icons.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the mobile channel header UI, including header menu, buttons, and conditional headings.
